title: Cohort-first Q2 roadmap: hosted API model pairings & cost-hedge lanes
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Organize the Q2 roadmap for Hosted API + Model Catalog around customer cohorts (low volume/high value, high volume/low latency, research sandbox). Deliver a pairing matrix that maps cohort -> recommended model variants, latency/cost SLOs, and an operational lane (cost-hedge, performance-optimized, or fallback). This ticket coordinates PM, Eng, and Design to finalize commitments, canary windows, and guardrails for quality regressions tied to cohort-specific eval sets.
outcomes: OKR: Reduce hosted API cost-per-1M tokens for high-volume cohorts by 18% without increasing median P99 latency beyond 10%
Objective: Establish cohort pairing matrix and commit to model variants for Q2 with rollouts scheduled in two waves
Key Result: Define and publish 3 cohort-specific eval suites and automated regression alerts integrated into Optimize
milestones: Week 1: finalize cohort definitions and usage baselines (billing + telemetry)
Week 2: generate model pairing matrix and recommend quantization/profile per cohort
Week 4: engineering capacity plan and canary schedule approved
Week 6: run cohort-oriented dry-run during low-traffic window; collect quality & cost signals
Week 8: production rollout and post-rollout retrospective
risks: Quality regressions for low-latency cohorts if aggressive quantization is applied
Insufficient dedicated capacity in certain regions causing failed canaries
Cross-dependency on runtime kernel selection work (ENG-1842) may delay rollouts
Customer misunderstanding of cohort assignment leading to wrong model pairing
decisions: Adopt cohort taxonomy: 'Enterprise-Interactive', 'Scale-Batch', 'Research-Sandbox' as canonical buckets for Q2
Default to conservative quantization for Enterprise-Interactive; more aggressive for Scale-Batch
Use traffic-weighted canaries (5% -> 20% -> 60%) with automated rollback on eval regressions
notes: Related PR for canary runtime hooks: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1127
